summary: Frontend-only mobile regression verified series configuration, dynamic set/board status, manual rotation, three-board set rollover, and wider layout at the public Expo preview.

ui_bugs.issue: Header still renders literal 'OF 08' for every set size, despite SeriesStatus correctly showing the selected board count.

action_items: Replace Active header's hard-coded OF 08 with match.boardsPerSet and use the current board value.
critical_code_review_comments: History items still use board.number as the React key while board numbering resets at each set, creating duplicate keys after rollover.

Final-set crossover logic is present and SeriesStatus exposes CROSSOVER NEXT, but the crossover flow was not independently reached in the isolated follow-up browser session because AsyncStorage state does not persist between automation sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, settings selected Best of 3, 3 boards, manual rotation; status showed SET 1 OF 3 / Board 1 of 3, manual rotate was tappable, and completing three boards advanced to SET 2 OF 3 / Board 1 of 3. Wider 768px render had no error elements. A separate session starts from setup, so final crossover needs one continuous session through all sets.
rca_of_issue: Active inline component still formats its header with a literal OF 08 (index.tsx line 67), while SeriesStatus uses match.boardsPerSet correctly. History key remains only b.number although completeBoard resets board to 1 on set rollover.
